citations.claim: Requires allergens in a "Contains" statement immediately following the ingredient list, typically bold/contrasting
citations.evidence: 21 U.S.C. 343(w)(1): allergen declared EITHER by "Contains" printed "immediately after or is adjacent to the list of ingredients" OR by parenthetical in the list (B); a Contains statement is an alternative, not a requirement, and there is no bold/contrast requirement. The label has both.

citations.claim: Descending order; sugar and salt should be listed as separate items rather than "2 percent or less"
citations.evidence: 101.4(a)(2): the descending-order requirement does "not apply to ingredients present in amounts of 2 percent or less by weight when a listing of these ingredients is placed at the end of the ingredient statement following an appropriate quantifying statement, e.g., “Contains __ percent or less of ______”" — the label uses exactly this.

citations.claim: Requires a qualifying phrase such as "Manufactured by"
citations.evidence: 101.5(c): "Where the food is not manufactured by the person whose name appears on the label, the name shall be qualified by a phrase that reveals the connection" — conditional; 101.5(a) requires only "the name and place of business".

citations.claim: Requires storage instructions if necessary for safety/quality
citations.evidence: 21 CFR 101.17 (eCFR, fetched 2026-10-09) "Food labeling warning, notice, and safe handling statements": (a)-(h) self-pressurized containers, ozone-depleting substances, protein products, iron supplements, psyllium, unpasteurized juice, shell eggs — no general storage-instruction requirement.

otherClaims.claim: "Contains: almonds." separate rather than a proper allergen declaration — not-real: 343(w)(1)(A) Contains statement "immediately after or is adjacent to the list of ingredients" is exactly what is printed

"almonds (almonds)" redundant/erroneous, list once — not-real: 343(w)(1)(B)(i) parenthetical "is not required when the common or usual name of the ingredient uses the name of the food source"; permitted, not a violation
"Contains 2 percent or less of sugar, salt" vague/non-compliant; list sugar, salt separately — not-real: 101.4(a)(2) permits "Contains __ percent or less of ______"

Possibly missing storage instructions — not-real: 101.17 has no general storage-instruction requirement; shelf-stable granola

citations.claim: Servings per container must be properly rounded; 8 is wrong for 8.5
citations.evidence: 101.9(b)(8)(i): "The number of servings shall be rounded to the nearest whole number ... Rounding should be indicated by the use of the term about". 340 g / 40 g = 8.5 (12 oz = 340.2 g, 8.505) — nearest whole number is 9, not 8.

citations.claim: Prescribes footnote text including "(DV)"; abbreviated footnote only on small packages
citations.evidence: 101.9(d)(9) has no subparagraph (i) (text runs on to (d)(10)); and the prescribed footnote has no "(DV)": "*The % Daily Value tells you how much a nutrient in a serving of food contributes to a daily diet. 2,000 calories a day is used for general nutrition advice."

citations.claim: Added Sugars indented and worded "Includes 0g Added Sugars"
citations.evidence: 101.9(c)(6)(iii): "Added sugars content shall be indented under Total Sugars and shall be prefaced with the word “Includes” followed by the amount (in grams) “Added Sugars”". Label prints "Added Sugars 0g".

citations.claim: "almonds (almonds)" redundant; list almonds once
citations.evidence: § 101.4 has no rule against a parenthetical repeating the ingredient name. 21 U.S.C. 343(w)(1)(B)(i): the parenthetical food source "is not required when the common or usual name of the ingredient uses the name of the food source" — not required, not prohibited; redundant, not a violation.

citations.claim: Requires naming the specific tree nut; "Contains: almonds" is fine
citations.evidence: 21 U.S.C. 343(w)(2): for "a tree nut ... the name of the specific type of nut"; (w)(1)(A) "Contains" followed by the food source name, "immediately after or is adjacent to the list of ingredients".

citations.claim: Fortificants must appear in the ingredient list
citations.evidence: 101.4(a)(1): ingredients "shall be listed by common or usual name in descending order of predominance by weight" — added fortificants are ingredients.

citations.claim: Fortification must comply with 104.20

Not a binding requirement to "comply" with.

citations.evidence: 101.12(b) Table 2: "Breakfast cereals, ready-to-eat, weighing 43 g or more per cup; biscuit types" — 60 g, not 55 g (the 20 to <43 g/cup category is 40 g).

citations.claim: Fortificants must appear in the ingredient list
citations.evidence: 101.4(a)(1): ingredients "shall be listed by common or usual name in descending order of predominance by weight" — added fortificants are ingredients.

citations.claim: Add "Distributed by"/"Manufactured for" if not the manufacturer
citations.evidence: 101.5(c): "Where the food is not manufactured by the person whose name appears on the label, the name shall be qualified by a phrase ... “Manufactured for ______”, “Distributed by ______”"; (d) street address, city, State, ZIP.

citations.claim: Type ≥ 3/16 in; bottom 30%, parallel to base; distinct from other text
citations.evidence: No § 101.105 (eCFR 404, 2026-10-09). The substance is in 101.7: (f) "within the bottom 30 percent of the area of the label panel in lines generally parallel to the base", separated "by at least a space equal to the height of the lettering" above/below; (h) boldface, distinct contrast; (i)(3) "Not less than three-sixteenths inch in height ... more than 25 but not more than 100 square inches".

citations.claim: Statement of identity on PDP, bold, reasonably related size
citations.evidence: 101.3(d): "shall be presented in bold type on the principal display panel, shall be in a size reasonably related to the most prominent printed matter on such panel, and shall be in lines generally parallel to the base".

citations.claim: Nutrition Facts type sizes, bold, rules
citations.evidence: 101.9(d)(1)(iii): (d)(7)/(8) information "in type size no smaller than 8 point"; "Calories" declaration "highlighted in bold or extra bold and ... no smaller than 16 point"; (d)(3)(i) servings per container no smaller than 10 point.

citations.claim: Specific tree nut must be named; "Contains: almonds" correct
citations.evidence: 21 U.S.C. 343(w)(2): for "a tree nut ... the name of the specific type of nut"; (w)(1)(A) "Contains" followed by the food source name, "immediately after or is adjacent to the list of ingredients".

citations.claim: Confirm no sesame or other cross-contact in the formulation
citations.evidence: FASTER Act (Pub. L. 117-11) not among the primary sources and not fetched; the sesame/cross-contact point cannot be verified from text here.

otherClaims.claim: Added Sugars line lacks "Includes" wording (101.9(c)(6)(iii))
Sodium 0 mg / Added Sugars 0 g conflict with salt and sugar in ingredients (listed as a "clear problem" but conceded acceptable if amounts are that low)

Potassium %DV wrong: 235/4,700 = 5%, should be 5% not 6% — not-real: 101.9(c)(8)(iii) "nearest 2-percent increment up to and including the 10-percent level" (5% is not a permitted value) and (d)(8) itself gives "Potassium 235 mg 6%"

"almonds (almonds)" redundant/erroneous, list once — not-real: 343(w)(1)(B)(i) parenthetical "is not required when the common or usual name of the ingredient uses the name of the food source"; permitted, not a violation
Footnote omits "(DV)" — not-real: 101.9(d)(9) "The footnote shall state: “*The % Daily Value tells you how much a nutrient ...”" (no "(DV)"); label matches exactly

Servings per container "8" inconsistent with 340 g / 40 g = 8.5; should round to 9 (101.9(b)(8)(i)) [lead: normalised to unclear — on the printed 340 g it is exactly 8.5, a tie 101.9(b)(8)(i) does not break; on 12 oz = 340.19 g it rounds to 9]
Serving size 1/2 cup (40 g) not closest household measure to the RACC — if RTE cereal ≥43 g/cup the RACC is 60 g and 3/4 cup (60 g) is closest; category not stated
Vitamin D / calcium / iron implausible for oats+almonds; fortificants missing from ingredients or values wrong — no recipe given
Add "Distributed by/Manufactured for" if Example Foods is not the manufacturer (101.5(c)) — conditional, facts not given

answers.notes: Caught with the correct FPLA paragraph, but four of its 101.105 citations are to a section that does not exist, plus non-existent (d)(9)(i) and (d)(7)(iii). Lists potassium and "(DV)" among seven "clear problems" — two of the seven are not-real. Ends "No other mandatory elements appear to be missing."
